name: Timmy Tracker
description: Tracks your Geometry Dash progress on The Timmylist: sends your best % and completions live, shows a level's rank and points, and adds a pop-up with your whole list.

link-code.name: Link code
link-code.description: Your link code from timmylist.org: Settings, Connected Accounts, Geometry Dash. Keep it private.

sync-on-launch.name: Sync on launch
sync-on-launch.description: When the game starts, send the best % you already have on Timmylist levels so earlier progress is saved too.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Small notices when the link works or fails.

completion-toast.name: Completion notice
completion-toast.description: Show a notice when you complete a Timmylist level for the first time, with the points you earned.

best-toast.name: New best notice
best-toast.description: Show a notice when you get a new best % on a Timmylist level.

menu-button.name: Main menu button
menu-button.description: Add the Timmy Tracker cube button to the main menu.

badge.name: Level page badge
badge.description: Show a level's Timmylist rank, points and your best on its level page.

hud.name: In-level display
hud.description: Show the level's Timmylist rank and your best % while you play.

hud-opacity.name: Display opacity
hud-opacity.description: How visible the in-level display is.

server.name: Server
server.description: Leave this as it is unless you run your own copy of the site.
